projects.title: MQT Qudits
projects.description: First open-source framework for mixed-dimensional quantum computing, featuring multiple simulators, a compiler, and a programming language based on OpenQASM 2.0.

projects.title: MQT MiSiM
projects.description: A C++ quantum circuit simulator for mixed-dimensional systems based on Decision Diagrams, capable of simulating circuits with more than 100 qudits.

projects.title: Quantum Molecular Docking
projects.description: Developed the first in silico drug discovery molecular docking algorithm on a quantum annealer, parallelized classical comparisons on the Marconi-100 supercomputer.

projects.title: Quantum Computing Libraries @ NVIDIA
projects.description: Quantum chemistry software development with performance focus, full-stack quantum error correction, and heterogeneous architecture support.
